checkpoint_rule.if_marginal: Hold the current target for another300 seconds; do not infer improvement from an incomplete startup window.
checkpoint_rule.if_worse: Return to the previous more productive target without cancelling active attempts.
checkpoint_rule.after128: Observe another full window before retaining128; use96 if errors or useful throughput regress.

handoff: Pause launches, finish registered attempts and relay requests, stop old controller, acquire both scheduler locks, then resume only never-started attempt IDs.
live_changes: One128-worker pool and a shared adjustable admission semaphore read the same atomic control file. Raising a target does not restart agent sessions. Lowering a target lets existing agents and admitted requests finish before filling fewer slots. Per-attempt recorded targets describe launch settings; requests spanning a change can experience the next admission limit. Capacity history and checkpoint times retain this confound.
analysis_note: Operational throughput checks do not establish a causal effect on safety or provider capacity. Immutable cases, framework images, per-attempt adapters, scoring, quotas and attempts remain unchanged. No retries are added.
